lina (People Ops): Quick Q — if a manager wants to appeal a leveling/comp decision after offers/letters are sent, what's the formal route? Is retro pay possible? @sasha any short pointers? TL;DR for managers pls.
ryan (Eng Manager): are appeals allowed after comp letters sent? we just had 1 case and manager's pretty urgent
sasha (Compensation): Short answer: yes, but there are constraints. Submit the `comp-change-request` form within 30 days of the comp/level notification. Retro pay is possible only if the approved increase has an effective date that fits payroll windows; we process a one-time adjustment on the next payroll after approval. Equity adjustments are handled separately and require committee sign-off. Full process and examples: https://confluence.redwood.company/comp/appeals
amanda (HRBP): managers — attach calibration notes + evidence against the leveling rubric. Do NOT just email recruiting or payroll, use the form so we get consistent audit trail.
ben (Finance): FYI payroll cutoff is the 10th of the month for retro adjustments. If approval comes after cutoff it will post on the following month's payroll. Also budget approval is required for out-of-band comp increases.
ryan (Eng Manager): :thinking_face: what's the committee cadence? if we submit today when's earliest we can get a decision?
sasha (Compensation): Committee meets Tuesdays for standard reviews; we have a small emergency triage but expect ~5-7 business days from complete submission to decision for most cases. Promotions that include equity typically take ~2 weeks due to grant cycles.
lina (People Ops): :white_check_mark: I'll add this to the manager checklist. Also note: outside-of-cycle promotions require manager + director sign-off and People Ops + Compensation review. Appeals submitted after 30 days are rare and need an exec sponsor with justification.
comp-bot: Reminder: new `comp-change-request` form auto-populates manager fields from Workday. Link: `/forms/comp-change-request` :robot_face:
ryan (Eng Manager): thanks — can you paste exact steps so i can DM my managers?
sasha (Compensation): Steps (short): 1) Manager completes `/forms/comp-change-request` and selects "Appeal/Adjustment". 2) Attach calibration notes, updated rubric evidence, and org chart. 3) People Ops triages within 2 business days and confirms completeness. 4) Compensation reviews and routes to the committee if needed. 5) Finance assesses payroll impact and budget. 6) Final decision recorded in Workday and manager is notified; if approved, compensation team sends payroll adjustment to Finance. I'll DM the evidence template.
amanda (HRBP): :thumbsup: I'll add an example packet to the manager playbook and link it from the form.
lina (People Ops): Ok, i'll update the manager checklist and post the new playbook link here when live. @here — heads-up to managers: appeals window = 30 days from comp notification, use `/forms/comp-change-request` and include calibration notes.
ryan (Eng Manager): :pray: appreciate it, will share with my directors.
sasha (Compensation): one more note — if the change would create a comp band compression or broader budget impact, we may propose an alternate remediation (e.g., phased increase). We'll always flag options rather than a hard "no".
ben (Finance): if anyone needs a quick budget pre-check before submitting, ping me and i'll do a quick feasibility check (no guarantees).
lina (People Ops): thanks all. i'll post the playbook link and a 1-page manager cheat sheet once it's up.
